newsitem.title: GREECE: XIOSBANK LAUNCHES MUTUAL FUND BRANCH.
newsitem.headline: XIOSBANK LAUNCHES MUTUAL FUND BRANCH.

text.p: Xiosbank launched its first mutual fund branch at Kolokotroni 1A with plans to expand with more such branches, it said on Wednesday.

"These branches will assist clients in their investment decisions with flexible risk/reward alternatives. The bank sees significant developments in the mutual fund industry following the drop in interest rates. Savers are now increasingly attracted to mutual funds," it said.

Xiosbank's assets under management are up 62 percent since the beginning of the year and have reached 125 billion drachmas. Its market share in the mutual fund market is 2.4 percent. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
